# Load necessary libraries
library(tibble)
library(readxl)

# Define the function
load.tapho.data <- function(file_path) {
  # Check file extension
  file_extension <- tools::file_ext(file_path)
  
  # Read the data based on file extension
  if (file_extension == "csv") {
    data <- read.csv(file_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else if (file_extension %in% c("xls", "xlsx")) {
    data <- read_excel(file_path)
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported file type. Please provide a CSV or Excel file.")
  }
  
  # Convert the data to a tibble
  data_tibble <- as_tibble(data)
  
  # Rename the first two columns to "element" and "count"
  colnames(data_tibble)[1:2] <- c("element", "count")
  
  # Print the tibble
  #print(data_tibble)
  
  # Return the tibble (optional)
  return(data_tibble)
}

# Example usage:
# tibble_data <- load.tapho.data("path_to_your_file.csv")
# tibble_data <- load.tapho.data("path_to_your_file.xlsx")

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(tibble)
library(readxl)

# Define the function
load.tapho.data <- function(file_path) {
  # Check file extension
  file_extension <- tools::file_ext(file_path)

  # Read the data based on file extension
  if (file_extension == "csv") {
    data <- read.csv(file_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else if (file_extension %in% c("xls", "xlsx")) {
    data <- read_excel(file_path)
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported file type. Please provide a CSV or Excel file.")
  }

  # Convert the data to a tibble
  data_tibble <- as_tibble(data)

  # Rename the first two columns to "element" and "count"
  colnames(data_tibble)[1:2] <- c("element", "count")

  # Ensure 'count' is numeric (if not already)
  data_tibble$count <- as.numeric(data_tibble$count)

  # Create the dataset tibble with specified structure
  dataset <- tibble(
    site_index = ifelse(
      !is.na(data_tibble$count[data_tibble$element == "site_index"]),
      data_tibble$count[data_tibble$element == "site_index"],
      sample(1:1000, 1)
    ),
    sample_index = paste0(
      site_index,
      "_",
      seq_along(data_tibble$element[data_tibble$element == "sample_index"])
    ),
    site_name = data_tibble$count[data_tibble$element == "site_name"],
    sum = data_tibble$count[data_tibble$element == "sum"],
    time_range = data_tibble$count[data_tibble$element == "time_range"],
    geological_context = data_tibble$count[data_tibble$element == "geological_context"],
    number_of_individuals = data_tibble$count[data_tibble$element == "number_of_individuals"],
    age = data_tibble$count[data_tibble$element == "age"],
    gender = data_tibble$count[data_tibble$element == "gender"],
    accumulation_cause = data_tibble$count[data_tibble$element == "accumulation_cause"],
    hominin_species = data_tibble$count[data_tibble$element == "hominin_species"],
    bone_level = summarize_bone_sections(data_tibble[-c(1:8),]),
    element = data_tibble[-c(1:8), ]$element,
    count = data_tibble[-c(1:8), ]$count
  )

  # Return the dataset tibble
  return(dataset)
}


```

```{r}
# TWO 
# Load necessary libraries
library(tibble)
library(readxl)

# Define the function
load.tapho.data <- function(file_path) {
  # Check file extension
  file_extension <- tools::file_ext(file_path)

  # Read the data based on file extension
  if (file_extension == "csv") {
    data <- read.csv(file_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else if (file_extension %in% c("xls", "xlsx")) {
    data <- read_excel(file_path)
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported file type. Please provide a CSV or Excel file.")
  }

  # Convert the data to a tibble
  data_tibble <- as_tibble(data)

  # Rename the first two columns to "element" and "count"
  colnames(data_tibble)[1:2] <- c("element", "count")

  # Ensure 'count' is numeric (if not already)
  data_tibble$count <- as.numeric(data_tibble$count)

  # Handle missing or empty data
  site_index_value <- ifelse(
    "site_index" %in% data_tibble$element,
    data_tibble$count[data_tibble$element == "site_index"],
    sample(1:1000, 1)
  )

  # Create sample indices
  sample_indices <- if ("sample_index" %in% data_tibble$element) {
    paste0(site_index_value, "_", seq_along(data_tibble$element[data_tibble$element == "sample_index"]))
  } else {
    paste0(site_index_value, "_", 1:10) # Default to 10 samples if missing
  }

  # Extract other fields or assign defaults
  extract_field <- function(field_name, default = NA) {
    if (field_name %in% data_tibble$element) {
      return(data_tibble$count[data_tibble$element == field_name])
    } else {
      return(default)
    }
  }

  # Define dataset tibble
  dataset <- tibble(
    site_index = site_index_value,
    sample_index = sample_indices,
    site_name = extract_field("site_name"),
    sum = extract_field("sum", 0),
    time_range = extract_field("time_range"),
    geological_context = extract_field("geological_context"),
    number_of_individuals = extract_field("number_of_individuals", 0),
    age = extract_field("age"),
    gender = extract_field("gender"),
    accumulation_cause = extract_field("accumulation_cause"),
    hominin_species = extract_field("hominin_species"),
    bone_level = summarize_bone_sections(data_tibble[-c(1:8), ]),
    element = data_tibble[-c(1:8), ]$element,
    count = data_tibble[-c(1:8), ]$count
  )

  # Return the dataset tibble
  return(dataset)
}



```

#map MNE -\> one_skeleton

#sum up and inconsistencies

```{r}
fill_missing_bones <- function(new_skeleton, complete_skeleton) {
  # Initialize a dataframe with the complete list of bones
  complete_bones <- data.frame(
    element = complete_skeleton$element,
    count = rep(NA, length(complete_skeleton$element))
  )
  
  # Iterate through the complete skeleton and fill in the corresponding values from the new skeleton
  for (i in 1:nrow(complete_bones)) {
    element_name <- complete_bones$element[i]
    
    if (element_name %in% new_skeleton$element) {
      complete_bones$count[i] <- new_skeleton$count[new_skeleton$element == element_name]
    }
  }
  
  return(complete_bones)
}
```
